$comment: THE PUBLISHED ORDER OF EVERY VARIANT DROPDOWN. Read by scripts/api/mqtt/variant_labels.py.
SINCE 2026-09-22 THE ORDER IS THE CONTRACT'S. By owner decision every dropdown lists its message's
examples in the contract's examples[] order -- the order of example_description.json in the API
definition -- and variant_labels.py checks that directly (CONTRACT ORDER), including that no
example is missing. This file keeps the `value` slugs pinned, so that an unintended reorder or a
renamed slug still fails loudly: VariantSelect.tsx:288 selects by `value`.
The docs-owned orders of 2026-09-09 (family-contiguous, plain-before-TLS) are retired; git history
WHY IT IS EXHAUSTIVE. Ordering specification 1.1: 'Make the list exhaustive, including the messages
that never change. A partial list appends silently when a source adds an example. A complete one
fails loudly, which is the point.' All 17 controls are listed.
TO CHANGE AN ORDER: change it upstream in example_description.json, rebuild the contract, then edit
the prose AND this file in the same commit.
